patthana22.28:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho hetusampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ
patthana22.28:2.1: na hetuvipputtaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho hetuvippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana22.28:3.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na hetuñceva na ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho hetu ceva sahetuko ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.28:4.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na ahetukañceva na na ca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho sahetuko ceva na ca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.28:5.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na hetuñceva na hetuvippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho hetu ceva hetusampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.28:6.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na hetuvippayuttañceva na na ca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho hetusampayutto ceva na na ca hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.28:7.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na hetuṃ na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho na hetu sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. na nidassana
patthana22.28:8.1: sappaṭighaṃ na hetuṃ na ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho na hetu ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekavīsa. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na sanidassanaṃ
